items.text: David Montgomery (groin) not expected to play Week 7 vs Giants after multiple DNPs; week-to-week.
items.why: Insider Aaron Wilson confirmation; no practice Wed/Thu.
items.implication: Misses another game; lead back role continues elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Woody Marks workhorse volume in good matchup vs NYG RB defense.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list; TE Elijah Arroyo undergoing shoulder surgery and will miss the rest of the season.
items.why: Full participant earlier; significant roster move confirmed by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Charbonnet debut possible vs KC; Arroyo season over opens TE opportunity in SEA.
items.opportunity: Potential lead back role expansion for Charbonnet if healthy; reverse any prior Jadarian Price stashes.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice on Thursday after earlier DNP.
items.why: Jets injury report shows return to practice; not ruled out.
items.implication: Trending toward availability vs MIA; monitor Friday for full clearance.
items.opportunity: Snap share rebound if active; handcuff Braelon Allen less urgent if full go.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role; Bears good for yardage; elite volume potential.
items.why: Removed from injury report; soft Bears secondary matchup + usage.
items.opportunity: Target share rebound in pass-friendly spot.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload questions post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot), Rome Odunze vs NE (nasty matchup/role).
items.why: Layoff/role squeeze for Jacobs/Skattebo; tough defenses for Odunze/Kelce/Downs.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive long-term on Jacobs facility access.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in facility for meetings/lifting/treatment (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess too. Discussed long-term on ROS pod.
items.why: Facility access positive signal; backups inefficient EPA data.
items.implication: Jacobs return looms positively; fade backups until then.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down work returns to Jacobs when cleared.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week due to layoff/workload questions.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) expected to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs DAL.
items.why: Garafolo/NFL Network report; efficient in prior full games.
items.implication: RB1 upside returns vs soft DAL matchup.
items.opportunity: Full snap share and goal-line work; reverse any Pierce/Blue beneficiaries.

items.text: Week 7 snaps/pace: Up - TB@CAR, GB@DET, LAR@LV (high volume/explosives). Slogs - MIA@NYJ, SF@ATL, IND@MIN. Neutral pace/PROE data drives fantasy environments.
items.why: Thorman analysis of neutral pace, POE, PROE, combined snaps, explosives.
items.implication: Prioritize players in up-pace games for higher floors/ceilings.
items.opportunity: Elevated play volume boosts all skill positions in TB/CAR/GB/DET/LAR/LV.

items.text: With Davante Adams out 6-10 weeks and Terrance Ferguson recovery delayed ('will take some time'), Rams answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson not ready off IR; Adams long-term absence confirmed.
items.implication: Puka elite WR1 volume floor/ceiling elevated ROS.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets monopoly in high-pace Rams offense vs LV.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions gift to pass catchers), Jaylen Warren @ NO (big workload friendly matchup).
items.why: Usage + matchup themes; Lions/NO defenses carved up.
items.implication: Start with confidence in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets for Smith/Kraft; carries for Warren.

items.text: Loves Chuba Hubbard vs TB (consistent workload), Bucky Irving @ CAR (friendly RB matchup), Jordan Love @ DET (easy points in high-total game).
items.why: Big workloads + defenses allowing RB production; Packers-Lions shootout.
items.opportunity: High carries/snaps in positive game scripts.

items.text: Bears RB Kyle Monangai ruled out Thursday night vs Patriots; misses third straight (thumb/turf toe).
JJ McCarthy starting for Giants vs HOU; yards per target to Justin Jefferson under McCarthy only 5.7 vs 9.9-10.8 under prior QBs. Tough sample but concern remains.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency risk short-term; monitor targets vs HOU.
items.opportunity: Still high volume but lower YAC/YPT potential.
items.conflict: Berry/others may still love volume regardless of QB.

items.text: Bears soft ROS after Week 10 bye: Saints (27th YPP allowed), Lions (24th), Jags (26th), Dolphins (21st), Bills (25th), Packers (3rd), Lions. Recent scoring spikes with healthier QB play.
items.why: Post-bye schedule vs bottom defenses; offense showing life.
items.implication: Bears skill players buy-low ROS value.
